title: Promote the next vuoro-cloud deployment generation (v0.1.0-poc.N)

blockers.description: vuoro-cloud#353 (P5) merged at main bcc55a9 (2026-11-07T14:20Z). The main push CI run (Forgejo Actions run id 2088) and publish-image run (id 2089) for bcc55a9 were in progress at that time, so PROMOTION_EXPECTED_HEAD can be bcc55a9 but its canonical OCI digest is not known yet.
blockers.resolved_by: coordinator: once publish-image run 2089 succeeds, freeze bcc55a9 (or a later reviewed head), read the digest from that run, and fill steps 2 and 4

why_operator: The promotion declaration is signed with the dedicated OpenPGP promotion identity AB73 C1C5 617B 5098 038C DA95 3AF9 5EDE B824 3BE7 on the owner's YubiKey (touch to sign). Key availability is not release authorization; each generation needs scope-specific approval.

preconditions.check: Newest deployment tag on canonical Forgejo, so N is the next integer
preconditions.command: git ls-remote --tags origin 'v0.1.0-poc.*' | sed 's#.*refs/tags/##' | grep -v '\^{}' | sort -t. -k4 -n | tail -1
preconditions.expected: v0.1.0-poc.81 (so N = 82) unless another promotion happened since

preconditions.check: Local main equals the frozen reviewed head and has no tracked changes
preconditions.command: git fetch origin && git status -sb && git rev-parse origin/main
preconditions.expected: ## main...origin/main with no tracked modifications; origin/main equals the frozen head

preconditions.check: Promotion keyring present and YubiKey answers
preconditions.expected: Signature key line showing AB73 C1C5 617B 5098 038C DA95 3AF9 5EDE B824 3BE7

commands.command: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
PROMOTION_EXPECTED_HEAD=<frozen 40-hex head> scripts/promote-release.sh sha256:<canonical OCI digest> 82
commands.expected: Two YubiKey touches; branch and tag v0.1.0-poc.82 pushed to origin; a Forgejo PR URL printed with the next steps

commands.command: fj pr merge <PR number printed in step 2> -M fast-forward-only

curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -H "Authorization: token $(cat ~/.config/forgejo/workstation-scope-token)" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://git.apps.kotona.app/api/v1/repos/bayleaf/vuoro-cloud/actions/workflows/promote-deployment.yaml/dispatches -d '{"ref":"v0.1.0-poc.82","inputs":{"deployment_tag":"v0.1.0-poc.82","image_digest":"sha256:<canonical OCI digest>"}}'

expected_result: Signed tag v0.1.0-poc.82 on Forgejo and the private GitHub replica with identical object IDs, the same OCI digest in GHCR, a promotion receipt, and Flux selecting the tag.
send_back: The PR number and the promote-deployment run ID with its final status
Output of: git ls-remote --tags origin v0.1.0-poc.82 and git ls-remote --tags github v0.1.0-poc.82
Any refusal text from promote-release.sh or the workflow, verbatim

rollback.description: Image rollback is a new higher signed tag pinning the previous accepted digest (D-037/D-038); tags are never moved or deleted. Migrations are forward-only and expand/contract (migration plan), so the previous image must run against the expanded schema: check the migration plan's rollback rule and the credential-rotation runbook's image-only rollback hazards before re-promoting. Before step 4 nothing is deployed: abandon by closing the PR and leaving the tag unused.
commands: PROMOTION_EXPECTED_HEAD=<new frozen head> scripts/promote-release.sh sha256:<previous accepted digest> <N+1>
